scene.head: tilt
scene.placeText: the square granite frame at the top of the bottle-shaped star tower of her steam city on a clear autumn night — a brass ladder rising through the opening below, a great brass armillary sphere turning on its iron stand beside her, the gaslit meadow far below and round grass-green mounds rolling away under strings of lamps
scene.ownProp: a palm-sized brass star dial shaped like a little bottle-shaped tower of stacked rings, its square window glowing with captured starlight
scene.outfit: a star-tower almanac keeper look fitted to her body — an off-shoulder corseted bodice of deep night-violet silk with a sweetheart neckline, a short front skirt sweeping back into a long bustled train, twenty-four tiny brass sun-and-star marks embroidered round the hem, lace fingerless gloves and a feathered hair ornament pinned with a brass sun-and-moon disc
scene.scene: she is the almanac keeper of the star tower, standing on the stone frame at the top and holding her brass star dial up against the night sky to read the turning of the seasons from the stars
